name.description: upload: the new file's name; attach/detach: an existing file's exact name

nqe_name.description: upload: the field name under network.extensions a query reads it by (default: name without its extension)

file_type.description: upload: CSV, JSON, XML, YAML or TEXT (XLSX and STIG are not handled by this skill)

headers.description: upload: CSV only, column names for a file with no header row

network_id.description: attach/detach: the network to attach the file to or detach it from
